parsed.explanation: Thin-data jurisdiction; extrapolating from structural signals. No offence targets trans presentation; the 2016 repeal removed the same-sex-conduct statute, so no criminal lever exists even as a dead letter. No documented trans-specific violence, police targeting, facility bans, or border friction — silence here, in a state with functioning institutions that decriminalised and signed the 2011 SOGI statement, is a moderately positive signal (rule 3/18). A written gender-identity non-discrimination rule in immigration detention is a documented, if narrow, protection. Negatives: bottom-tier 2025 equality index placement, no recognition or anti-discrimination protections for trans people, and total silence on prison placement and everyday social attitudes — open questions, not exposures, but they hold the score a step below documented-acceptance jurisdictions like the 0.65-C anchor. Deriving: no traveler-facing exposure beyond uncertainty plus thin formal recourse lands at reduced risk, ~0.63.
